decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using Goryo's Vengeance or Fallaji Archaeologist. It also includes various instant reanimation spells and control elements to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. The strategy involves using cards like Psychic Frog and Solitude for card advantage and removal while setting up the combo pieces. The deck aims to create a powerful board presence early in the game and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful reanimated creature.

Utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and flicker effects, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of threats. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. The inclusion of blink effects like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate allows for added value from entering the battlefield abilities, creating a versatile and proactive game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Shardless Agent, Force of Negation, and Generous Ent to control the board and protect your combo pieces. The goal is to cycle through your deck quickly using cards like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries, eventually casting Living End to return all your creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupt their strategy while setting up your combo for a big payoff.

The main concept of this deck is to use Ruby Storm combo pieces to generate mana and card advantage in order to cast powerful spells and win the game quickly. By utilizing cards like Ruby Medallion and Pyretic Ritual to reduce mana costs, along with Ral, Monsoon Mage's ability to copy spells, the deck aims to chain together spells like Past in Flames and Glimpse the Impossible to create a storm of spells and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes efficient land fetching and card draw to help achieve this combo as quickly as possible.

The deck revolves around utilizing affinity mechanics to play artifacts quickly and efficiently. It focuses on assembling a board state with artifact creatures and generating mana through cards like Springleaf Drum and Mox Opal. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Metallic Rebuke and Tormod's Crypt to control the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble helps provide card advantage and further enhance the deck's synergies. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful aggro strategy using artifact creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing ramp and control elements to accelerate the casting of powerful Eldrazi creatures, such as Emrakul, the Promised End. It uses cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and Sowing Mycospawn to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also ramping up mana with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Curiosity. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Emrakul while maintaining control of the game with removal spells like Kozilek's Return and Thought-Knot Seer.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. It combines creatures with various abilities and spells to create a fast-paced and versatile strategy. The key to success lies in deploying threats early and maintaining pressure throughout the game. Utilizing a mixture of aggressive creatures, removal spells, and support cards, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plans and secure victory through quick and decisive plays. By efficiently utilizing its resources and constantly applying pressure, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to claim victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo of reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard using cards like Persist and Unearth, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. By filling the graveyard with cards such as Thought Scour and Faithless Looting, the player can quickly set up their combo. The deck also includes a variety of lands to help fix mana and support the diverse range of colors needed for the strategy. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures and then use cards like Persist and Unearth to bring them back onto the battlefield. By combining powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty with reanimation spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence. This combo-focused approach allows for explosive plays and can catch opponents off guard, especially in the early game. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to help protect its game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to quickly search for and combo off with Allosaurus Rider and other big creatures like Griselbrand and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. Planar Genesis helps ramp up the mana quickly, while cards like Consign to Memory and Pact of Negation provide protection and control. The deck aims to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential. Veil of Summer and Atraxa, Grand Unifier provide additional support and versatility, making it a versatile and aggressive combo deck in the Modern format.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly generate mana with cards like Ruby Medallion, Pyretic Ritual, and Desperate Ritual, in order to play multiple spells in the same turn. By chaining together spells, the deck aims to build up storm count and eventually win the game with a massive Grapeshot. Ral, Monsoon Mage and Wrenn's Resolve help to dig for combo pieces while also providing control over the game. The deck is focused on setting up explosive turns and overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of spells.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting opponent's plays with a combination of counterspells and removal spells while drawing cards and gaining card advantage. The deck's key strategy involves controlling the board and tempo of the game through countering important spells, removing threats efficiently, and using Teferi, Time Raveler to dictate the pace of the game. The deck also utilizes bounce effects like Ephemerate and Subtlety to handle threats and disrupt opponent's plans. By managing resources effectively and out-valuing the opponent, this control deck aims to win through attrition and control of the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to establish early board presence with creatures like Ragavan and Seasoned Pyromancer, while also using Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge for direct damage to the opponent or removal of threats. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Elegant Parlor helps disrupt opponent's strategies, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride provide additional creature buffs for a decisive finish. Voice of Victory and Guide of Souls offer support and resilience to push through to victory.

This deck revolves around the synergy between Amulet of Vigor and Urza's Saga to quickly ramp up mana and cheat out powerful threats like Primeval Titan. By utilizing lands that can be untapped multiple times and land tutors like Tolaria West, the deck aims to generate a huge amount of mana and combo off with cards like Scapeshift to win the game in one explosive turn. The inclusion of cards like Explore and Arboreal Grazer help to accelerate the deck's game plan and ensure a consistent stream of threats and resources.

The deck focuses on rapidly filling the graveyard with creatures using cards like Faithless Looting and Thought Scour, then utilizing reanimation spells such as Unearth and Persist to bring back powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones. By quickly assembling a board presence and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combo of reanimated threats for a swift victory. The key strategy is to efficiently utilize graveyard resources for explosive plays and control the game through powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures while utilizing blink effects to protect and reuse valuable creatures. The deck also includes disruption spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's board state. By combining creatures with powerful abilities like Overlord of the Balemurk and Ephemerate, the deck can create powerful synergy and tempo advantage. Additionally, cards like Relic of Progenitus provide graveyard hate to counter opposing strategies. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure quickly and efficiently by combining aggressive creatures with blink effects and disruption spells.
